title: a field default is evaluated before construction even when the field is supplied
purpose: Defaults fill self first; a supplied shorthand value replaces the default afterwards.

stdout.text:
default evaluated
after supplied
default evaluated
5 7

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: language owner decision, 19.10.2026 (D-035, refined): before the constructor runs, every defaulted field is filled with its default; the constructor then binds the supplied values, replacing defaults; finally every field must be bound, otherwise construction fails. Stamp(id: 5) evaluates the default (prints) and then binds 5; Stamp() keeps 7.
